title: Reported speech: review
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.prompt: Last month, Tom said: "I'm leaving tomorrow." → Tom said he was leaving ___.
items.explanationEs: Lo dijo hace un mes: tomorrow pasa a the next day.

items.prompt: "Do you like jazz?" → She asked me ___ jazz.
items.explanationEs: Pregunta de sí o no: if + orden de afirmación, sin do.

items.statement: My mother told me to wear a coat.
items.explanationEs: Una orden o consejo: told + persona + to + verbo.

items.statement: He asked me where was the bank.
items.explanationEs: Orden de afirmación: He asked me where the bank was.

answers: They asked us what time it was.
items.explanationEs: Pregunta indirecta con palabra interrogativa: what time + it was.

items.text: "Don't open the window," he said. → He told me ___ the window.
items.explanationEs: Orden negativa: told + persona + not to + verbo.

items.text: "I saw Laura," Sam said. → Sam said he ___ Laura.
items.explanationEs: El pasado da un paso atrás: had seen. Saw también se oye mucho.

items.sentence: She told that she was tired.
items.explanationEs: Sin a quién, say: She said that she was tired.
